title: Requirement
description: One immutable version snapshot of a tester-facing requirement, stored as requirements/<id>.v<version>.json inside a project directory. Field names follow the entity table in docs/loom-work-vision.md, so the same document is the contract between the store, the browser UI, and any agent that extracts requirements from source documentation.

version.description: Version of this snapshot, starting at 1. Every version is retained and retrievable; there is no diff view.

source_type.description: System of record for the originating documentation. Absent for requirements a QA engineer authored without a source document.

source_ref.description: Back-reference into the source system: ADO story id or URL, Confluence page URL, GitHub document URL.

status.description: active: current and testable. obsolete: retained for audit, no longer testable. superseded: a newer version of the same requirement id exists.

origin.description: How the version was produced. Both paths write the same schema to the same store.

metadata.description: Provenance for extracted requirements (provider, model, source document, prompt digest) or any other non-semantic annotation.

created_at.description: When this version was written (UTC, RFC 3339).

index.title: RequirementIndex
index.description: requirements/index.json: the current-version pointer per requirement id, so loading a project does not require reading every version file.
